description: Implementation of the RRC Resume Procedure for a 5G NR UE, including security verification, message handling, and state management.

classes.name: rrc_resume_procedure
classes.description: Class implementing the RRC Resume procedure, managing message exchange, security checks, and state updates.

methods.name: operator()
methods.description: Main coroutine handling the resume procedure workflow, including security verification, request notification, message sending, and response handling.

methods.name: handle_rrc_resume_failure
methods.description: Handles failure in RRC resume, including notifying metrics and requesting UE release.

methods.name: verify_and_update_security_context
methods.description: Verifies the security context of the resume request and updates security keys and SRBs.

methods.name: update_security_keys
methods.description: Refreshes security keys based on current configuration.

methods.name: reestablish_srbs
methods.description: Reestablishes Signaling Radio Bearers (SRBs) after resume.

methods.name: send_rrc_resume
methods.description: Sends an RRC Resume message to the UE.

methods.name: send_pending_dl_nas
methods.description: Sends pending downlink NAS messages after successful resume.
